title: Miller's own fast-fingering style
summary: Miller says he was called the fast finger, did not learn it from anyone, and mentions his feature piece.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Okay. What about your own style? What do you think makes your style different from others?

Well, I don't know. I had an idea. I always try and do a lot of fingering, see? And that's what they used to call me, the fast finger. I don't know. I didn't pick it up from nobody. I just do it. I just start off like that, see?
So your number that really featured your finger in the olden times, what number would you play to really show?
Well the show thing I used to call my feature.
